pr.title: Add unit tests for `TextureRect`
pr.body:
Contributes to #43440

Adds unit tests for `TextureRect` covering:

- Default property values (`texture`, `expand_mode`, `stretch_mode`, `flip_h`, `flip_v`, `mouse_filter`)
- `set_texture` / `get_texture` round-trip and clearing
- All `ExpandMode` values (6) and `StretchMode` values (7)
- `flip_h` and `flip_v` toggling and independence
- Minimum size with `EXPAND_KEEP_SIZE` and `EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE` using a real `ImageTexture` of known dimensions (in-tree with `process(0)` to flush the minimum size cache)
- Configuration warnings for `STRETCH_TILE` with an `AtlasTexture` that has a non-zero margin

AI disclosure: I designed the test plan, wrote every line, and ran pre-commit and the test suite locally. Claude Sonnet 4.6 helped with initial research and drafting.
